mainEntity.name: What is the difference between local SEO and GEO marketing for law firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local SEO is a subset of GEO marketing. Local SEO specifically focuses on optimizing a law firm's online presence to rank higher in local search results, particularly on Google Maps and local search packs. GEO marketing is a broader term that encompasses all marketing efforts aimed at a specific geographic area, which includes local SEO but also extends to geo-targeted paid ads, social media campaigns, and localized content strategies. For law firms, both are critical for attracting clients within their service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local SEO is a part of GEO marketing. Local SEO optimizes for local search rankings, while GEO marketing is a broader strategy targeting a specific geographic area, including local SEO and other efforts.
